mapper.select: select eea.ASSET_TYPE1 as assetType1 /*回购类型*/ from ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea where eea.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
select ed.TRADER as tradeId /*交易员*/ from ETR_DISTRIBUTE ed where ed.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

SELECT A.ENTRUST_ID as entrustId, /*委托代码*/ A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, /*金融产品代码*/ A.INV_AIM as invAim, /*投资目的*/ A.BUSINESS_MODEL as businessModel, /*业务模式*/ A.COUNTER_ID as counterId, /*交易对手*/ A.ENTRUST_NUM * 100 entrustNum /*券面总额*/ FROM ETR_ENTRUST A WHERE A.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

SELECT A.ENTRUST_ID as entrustId, /*委托代码*/ A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, /*金融产品代码*/ A.ENTRUST_NUM as entrustNum , /*券面总额*/ A.ENTRUST_AMT as entrustAmt,/*委托额度，交易金额*/ A.PS as ps /**交易方向*/ FROM ETR_ENTRUST A WHERE A.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
mapper.update: update ETR_ENTRUST set ENTRUST_STATUS = #{entrustStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
UPDATE TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL T SET T.MDATE = #{mdate,jdbcType=DATE},T.UNIT_CPRICE = #{unitCprice} WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T.TRADE_MARKET = '04' AND T.PS IN ('03','04')
UPDATE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T SET T.MDATE = #{mdate,jdbcType=DATE},T.UNIT_CPRICE = #{unitCprice} WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T.TRADE_MARKET = '04' AND T.PS IN ('03','04')
mapper.select: SELECT FINPROD_ID as finprodId, BRANCH as branch, OTH_TYPE as othCodeType, OTH_CODE as othCode, REMARK as remark FROM FIN_PRODUCT_OTH_CODE WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OTH_TYPE = #{othCodeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select FINPROD_ID from INF_CONTRACT_DETAILFILE where DEAL_NO=#{getvTradeId}

SELECT F2.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID pledgeFinprodId, F2.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, F2.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100 pledgeTradeAmt, F2.PLEDGE_RATIO pledgeRatio, F2.PLEDGE_NUMBER * F2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE pledgeFaceValue, F.PRIN prin, F.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE F2 ON F.FINPROD_ID = F2.FINPROD_ID AND F2.BRANCH = F.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE F3 ON F3.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID AND F3.BRANCH = F.BRANCH AND F3.TYPE_6 = 'H01' AND F3.TYPE_7 = '03' WHERE F.FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND F.BRANCH = 0
